title: Fortémi — examples gallery
subtitle: 20 runnable @fortemi/* examples, from one complete application to focused implementation patterns.

tiers.name: Complete application
tiers.blurb: Start here to see Fortemi used as the data primitive behind a real product workflow, with complexity revealed only when the user needs it.

examples.title: knowledge-workspace
examples.teaser: A Magly-derived local-first research and notes workspace: shard reader, search, writes, semantic retrieval, AI enrichment, SKOS, PROV, and optional relationship views.

tiers.name: Graph stack
tiers.blurb: The @fortemi/graph views as a standalone product — any CommunityGraph / RenderGraph, no database, no downloads.

examples.title: graph-svg-vanilla
examples.teaser: Hand-authored graph → renderCommunityGraph SVG. Zero framework.

examples.title: graph-view-static
examples.teaser: The PGlite-free React GraphView with selection + the shared filter contract.

examples.title: graph-2d-live
examples.teaser: SigmaGraphView — ForceAtlas2 settle, hover dimming, click-focus, palettes.

examples.title: graph-3d-orbit
examples.teaser: ForceGraph3DView — 3D orbit/zoom, lazy-loaded three.js.

examples.title: snapshot-baking
examples.teaser: bakeRenderGraph at build time → loadRenderSnapshot warm start, zero runtime layout.

examples.title: graph-controls-playground
examples.teaser: One control panel over the shared filter contract, switchable across all three renderer tiers.

examples.title: custom-canvas-renderer
examples.teaser: Render a RenderGraph to a hand-written <canvas> — the data-prep layer feeds any surface.

tiers.name: Data tier
tiers.blurb: The full Fortémi database — PGlite (Postgres in WASM) — inside the tab, no server.

examples.title: notes-crud-minimal
examples.teaser: The complete note lifecycle — useNotes / useCreateNote / useUpdateNote / useDeleteNote, soft-delete.

examples.title: search-basic
examples.teaser: Postgres full-text search (useSearch, mode:'text'), suggestions, ts_headline snippets, facets — no model.

examples.title: shard-reader
examples.teaser: exportShard bakes a .shard; useShard browses it read-only with no PGlite on the reader side.

examples.title: shard-exchange
examples.teaser: Two independent in-memory instances exchange a .shard with a conflict strategy.

examples.title: notes-graph-explorer
examples.teaser: Derive a CommunityGraph from note tags, explore with GraphView, useNote on click — no embeddings.

examples.title: aiwg-index-map
examples.teaser: Project an AIWG artifact index with useAiwgIndex → toCommunityGraph; communities are the artifact types.

examples.title: local-ai-setup
examples.teaser: Detect tier, discover local servers, opt-in enable('semantic') to download an embedding model, watch useJobQueue.

examples.title: remote-backend
examples.teaser: The starters' note-list + search UI, sourced from a Fortémi server via useRemote. The local/remote seam.

tiers.name: Composed applications
tiers.blurb: Focused hooks wired into whole surfaces.

examples.title: knowledge-garden
examples.teaser: Notes CRUD + search + tag-graph + detail sharing one selection over one PGlite database.

examples.title: docs-atlas
examples.teaser: Build-time markdown → tag-similarity graph → baked snapshot; runtime PGlite-free graph + reader. Deployable static.

examples.title: research-workbench
examples.teaser: Papers with attachments, SKOS concepts, citations, and W3C PROV-style source and derivation metadata over one PGlite database.

examples.title: dual-instance-sync
examples.teaser: Two divergent instances converge by exchanging shards both ways — idempotent, server-less sync.
